Security Awareness: Spotting Prompt Injection

Attackers sometimes hide text in a document that tries to make an AI assistant 'ignore its previous instructions' or reveal its system prompt. In this module we explain how these attempts look, why they work, and how our review process catches them before any action is taken.

This note describes, for our blue team, how multi-turn 'jailbreak' prompts gradually push a model into a permissive persona across several messages. We document the pattern so analysts can recognise it in logs. No action is required from readers of this brief.
